scope: Local on-device model selection; no provider, relay, download or benchmark work

identity.artifactSHA256: Verified main artifact SHA256, or SHA256 of the ordered verified multipart identity; unknown identity is ineligible
identity.runtimeID: Fingerprint of pinned runtime manifest, patches and inference implementation; current compiled capability remains authoritative
identity.backendID: The registered execution runtime, never inferred from a stored performance record; do not label requested GPU offload as confirmed execution
identity.environmentID: Local fingerprint of nonunique hardware/OS/driver and execution configuration; excludes account, user and device identifiers

storage.payload: Numeric measurements and bounded execution identities only; no prompts, output, paths or credentials
storage.writes: Atomic bounded replacement; failed writes preserve previous data and never fail a chat
storage.invalidInput: Reject malformed, oversized, nonfinite, failed, cancelled and incompatible samples; corrupt history falls back to estimates

selection.comparable: Exact artifact, runtime, backend, environment and effective context capacity; matching prompt bucket and candidate's expected cache mode; nominal thermal state. Exact repeated reports do not increase confidence. Candidate cacheMode defaults to the request cacheMode only when omitted. A retained model may reuse a prefix; a freshly loaded alternative uses cold evidence. Never pool those populations.
selection.prediction: Median(prefillMs / promptTokens * requestedPromptTokens + decodeMs / decodedTokens * expectedOutputTokens), plus median(loadMs) when switching
selection.hysteresis: Switch only if the candidate costs at most 80 percent of the current model; deterministic ID tie break
selection.unknown: Keep the viable current model without comparable evidence; existing selector may recommend an eligible installed fallback when current is unavailable
selection.execution: Persisted explicit opt-in. One admitted switch before the first ordinary inference of a new conversation through the existing loader; then retain its explicit model pin. Guided turns do not consume that first ordinary inference; legacy descriptive model metadata is not a pin. No midstream change, destination change or automatic download. Manual choices disable Automatic and survive relaunch. Preserve accessible conversation-scoped drafts/documents/history, validate the actual target's full pending request and response budget, and recover the previous model once on a failed switch.
